next_action: bee close finished "paseo-worker-subagent" — feature is closed.

route.rationale: paseo run keeps the caller env so the worker is the lead's child; other paseo calls stay scrubbed

cells.title: Start Paseo workers as subagents of the calling lead
cells.action: Per decision c09228a8. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/paseo.rs add a second method to trait PaseoCli (about line 802): fn call_as_caller(&self, args: &[String]) -> Result<String, String>, with a default body that returns self.call(args) so every fake keeps working. RealPaseoCli implements it like call but spawns WITHOUT removing AGENT_SCOPE_VARS (give run_with_deadline a keep_scope: bool, or an unscrubbed twin of scrubbed_command); call itself stays scrubbed. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs execute_paseo (about line 3623) start the worker with cli.call_as_caller(&argv) instead of cli.call(&argv); keep resolve_paseo_workspace and --workspace exactly as they are, and keep every other paseo call (ls_label_argv fallback, inspect, wait, archive, send, workspace calls, prepare probe) on the scrubbed path. The --env pairs given to the worker still exclude AGENT_SCOPE_VARS. Tests red first: beside paseo_children_do_not_see_agent_scope_vars (paseo.rs about line 1786, same env lock and restore) add a test that RealPaseoCli call_as_caller, plain and with_timeout, DOES see PASEO_AGENT_ID and PASEO_AGENT_CWD, while call still does not; in run.rs, with the existing fake PaseoCli used by the execute_paseo tests, assert the run argv goes through call_as_caller and the other calls do not (record which method each argv used). In docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/the-paseo-channel.md rewrite the lines that say a worker has no ParentAgentId and that every paseo process runs without the two variables (about lines 96, 217, 441) to state: the worker-starting paseo run keeps them so the worker is the lead's subagent, other paseo processes run without them, citing c09228a8 and that it narrows 57793b86 D5; add c09228a8 to the frontmatter decisions list. Write no code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee herding::

truths: the paseo run that starts a worker keeps PASEO_AGENT_ID and PASEO_AGENT_CWD
every other paseo process bee starts runs without them
the worker run still carries --workspace inside Paseo
the worker --env pairs still exclude PASEO_AGENT_ID and PASEO_AGENT_CWD
prohibitions: no change to resolve_paseo_workspace or the refuse-before-spawn rule
